coverage_exempt.reason: Unreachable for valid ordinary image and allocator inputs: 0x4bf45e/0x4bf460 require the allocated destination EDI nonzero before original 0x4bef50 is called at 0x4bf474; ESI is the valid input image address plus 0x20. Original 0x4bef50 returns zero only for a null destination (0x4bef59) or null source (0x4bef66), performs no outside calls, and otherwise returns one at 0x4bf05e. A valid image header cannot reside at 0xffffffe0 to wrap its payload to zero. Fixture mutations of heap fields cannot change these register-held pointer arguments; null allocation returns earlier at 0x4bf462. Owned body is retained.

Unreachable ordinary control flow: 0x4bf397 loads display format into EAX, 0x4bf39d/0x4bf3a0 set the local conversion flag to one exactly when that same EAX differs from eight. On the non-embedded-palette route 0x4bf4f7/0x4bf4fd require that flag nonzero to proceed. No call or EAX write intervenes before 0x4bf51f/0x4bf522, which must jump back because EAX differs from eight. Thus 0x4bf528 and its following return cannot execute; heap aliasing or fixture mutation cannot intervene in this call-free sequence. Owned body is retained.

Unsupported terminal access-fault outcome, not unreachable code: the operator-new fixture can return zero and this instruction sets ESI=0. The original then unconditionally dereferences address zero at 0x4bc58a, before any service/callback can repair the pointer. Ordinary Case return/physical-halt outcomes cannot represent terminal memory-fault equivalence; an emulator access fault is a harness failure and a native access fault is native-fault. Exempt only this allocation-null instruction from required coverage, retain the entire owned body and translated null path, and do not claim allocation-null fault equivalence.

Ordinary Case return/physical-halt outcomes cannot represent terminal memory-fault equivalence; an emulator access fault is a harness failure and a native access fault is native-fault. Exempt only this allocation-null instruction from required coverage, retain the entire owned body and translated null path, and do not claim allocation-null fault equivalence.

limits: Operator new uses the comparison allocator, not the original C runtime heap.
Operator delete uses the comparison release fixture, not the original C runtime heap.
CopyRect is a scripted Win32 import; cases provide its rectangle-copy effects.
DirectDraw and supplied virtual methods are case-controlled physical services; missing services fault.
0x4bb0e0 is semantic void for the reviewed menu caller domain; nonzero physical Unlock HRESULT is ignored and missing service remains a fault.
Original diagnostics remain executable with output-control globals disabled; OS dialogs and logging are not claimed.
Legacy GameImageRuntime.cpp and GameImageRuntime.h remain unchanged as the existing app API; this canonical module is source-only.
FindResourceA is a scripted physical Win32 resource service for original resource-image loading.
LoadResource is a scripted physical Win32 resource service for original resource-image loading.
LockResource is a scripted physical Win32 resource service for original resource-image loading.

Allocation-null terminal memory-fault equivalence is unverified for 0x4bc520 and 0x4ce3d0; their original null paths remain owned and must remain in translation, with narrow coverage exemptions for the unsupported fault outcome.
